Huzan Ul Islam

Agentic / Automation Tech Lead - Volvo Cars

LinkedIn - https://www.linkedin.com/in/huzan-ul-islam-a7b799a

Phone - +91 -7906023673

huzanulislam@yahoo.com

Professional Summary -

Experienced Consultant and Automation Developer with expertise in Agentic AI Development, Generative AI Integration, RPA (Blue Prism, Automation Anywhere, UiPath), Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI), Python Automation, and Process Optimization. Proven track record in delivering intelligent automation solutions, managing end-to-end projects, and implementing innovative technologies to drive business efficiency.

Education -

July 2014 - July 2018

University Of Petroleum and Energy Studies, Dehradun

Bachelor of Technology Computer Science with Specialisation in BFSI

Pre-University, Lucknow

Work History -

Volvo Cars, Bangalore, India

Agentic/Automation Tech Lead

December 2023 - Present

Key Responsibilities

Designed and delivered automation solutions across Blue Prism, Python, SAP, Salesforce, Azure, Microsoft DB, Browser Automation, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Power Pages, Dataverse, and GenAI platforms.



Collaborated with stakeholders for requirement gathering, dry runs, UAT, and smoke testing to ensure accuracy and business alignment.

Owned automation lifecycle end-to-end – from PDD/SDD documentation to development, deployment, and optimization.

Implemented AI-driven automation solutions leveraging multi-agent frameworks, RAG pipelines, LLM integrations, and Python-based microservices for enterprise workflows.

Developed dashboards and reporting solutions in Power BI for monitoring automation performance, SLA adherence, and cost savings.

Built low-code business apps and portals using Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Pages, Power Automate) integrated with Dataverse for business-critical workflows.

Created Python automation scripts for data processing, API integration, and ETL pipelines.

Mentored new team members, conducted knowledge-sharing sessions, and enabled best practices and CoE standards for automation.

Recognized with the Blue Prism Customer Excellence Award 2022 for impactful automation delivery.

Projects

Enterprise & Business Automation

Enterprise Onboarding Portal – Built on Power Pages, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and Dataverse; enabled automated workflows, document uploads, and multi-level approvals.

Vendor Payment Tracker App – Power Apps + Dataverse + Power Automate solution to streamline vendor payment processing and approval cycles.

Leave & Attendance Management Flow – Automated HR leave request and approval workflows using Power Automate.

Expense Reimbursement Workflow – Automated employee claims process via Power Apps & Power Automate integrated with Finance Dataverse tables.

Power Apps Asset Management System – Developed a low-code app with Dataverse backend for IT asset tracking and automated notifications.

Power Pages Supplier Collaboration Portal – Designed for supplier onboarding, document exchange, and approvals integrated with Power Automate & Dataverse.

Analytics & Insights

Cost Savings Dashboard – Built in Power BI, calculating Free Bot run cost savings and presenting executive-level insights.

RPA & Power BI Process Monitor – Integrated Blue Prism with Power BI to monitor bot performance and SLA compliance in real time.

Power BI Operations Dashboard – Consolidated ERP, RPA logs, and HR systems data to provide real-time operational insights.



Python Data Analytics Pipeline – Developed Python scripts using Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib for HR data analytics and operational insights beyond Power BI.

Agentic AI & GenAI Solutions

Agentic AI Knowledge Assistant – Multi-agent AI system using LangGraph, CrewAI, Autogen, Python, OpenAI GPT, Vector DBs, Groq API, and MCP for collaborative PDF/text Q&A with RAG pipelines.

Agentic AI Web Scraping & Summarization Pipeline – Python-based automation for web scraping (BeautifulSoup, Requests), GPT summarization, and PDF report generation.

Multi-Agent Process Automation Orchestrator – Python + AI-driven orchestration of

document processing, data validation, and insight generation integrated with RPA bots.

Python ETL Automation – Designed and deployed ETL pipelines in Python to extract data from APIs/Excel, transform it with Pandas, and load it into Dataverse & SQL DB.

Blue Prism + GenAI Integration – Enhanced Blue Prism workflows with Python + Generative AI for document classification and summarization.

RPA Automation (Blue Prism)

Blue Prism Invoice Processing Bot – Automated invoice extraction, validation, and ERP posting, reducing manual effort by 70%.

Blue Prism Email Automation Bot – Automated email categorization, attachment extraction, and report generation.

Cross-ERP Data Migration – Automated employee data migration between PeopleSoft and SAP HR with high accuracy.

Python + Blue Prism Hybrid Automation – Built Python services (via REST APIs) to extend Blue Prism capabilities for OCR, PDF parsing, and ML-based classification.

IT Service Desk Automation

Developed an automation for ticket triaging in ServiceNow using UiPath.

The bot categorized incidents, checked knowledge base for standard solutions, and auto- resolved low-priority tickets.

Reduced average handling time by 40% and minimized SLA breaches.

Deloitte, Bangalore, India

Consultant (Assistant Manager)



November 2021 - December 2023

Key Responsibilities

Designed and developed automation solutions across SAP, Microsoft DB, Microsoft Azure, Salesforce, Browser-based systems, Surface Automation, Cross-ERP platforms, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Python scripting, and PDF Generation using Blue Prism and Microsoft Power Platform.

Built Python automation scripts for data cleaning, file handling, web scraping, Excel/CSV processing, and PDF parsing to complement RPA workflows.

Collaborated with business stakeholders for requirement gathering, executed dry runs, and conducted UAT and smoke testing to ensure solution accuracy and reliability.

Delivered end-to-end automation ownership, including PDD/SDD documentation, development, deployment, and process optimization.

Led and implemented complex change requests, performing detailed impact analysis and delivering seamless process enhancements.

Partnered with business teams to provide user training, best practices, and adoption sessions across Blue Prism, Python automation, and Power Platform.

Administered Blue Prism environments, managing user profiles, roles, permissions, queues, and backups to maintain governance and security.

Built and automated workflows in Power Automate to streamline approvals, notifications, and data processing.

Designed and enhanced deployment guides, configuration documents, and operational manuals to strengthen delivery standards.

Created interactive Power BI dashboards to provide actionable insights into process performance, SLA adherence, and automation ROI.

Followed the system development life cycle (SDLC) from requirement analysis through successful implementation.

Mentored new joiners through the Deloitte Buddy Program and contributed to talent acquisition by conducting technical interviews.

Honored with the Blue Prism Customer Excellence Award 2022 for impactful automation delivery and best practice implementation.

Projects

Blue Prism & RPA Projects

SAP Invoice Automation – Automated invoice processing in SAP, validating records with Microsoft DB and generating PDF reports, reducing manual effort by 65%.

Salesforce Customer Data Automation – Automated customer onboarding workflows in Salesforce, integrated with Azure for document validation, and deployed successfully after UAT.



Cross-ERP Employee Data Migration – Automated employee data migration between PeopleSoft and SAP HR using surface automation, ensuring accuracy and compliance.

Insurance Policy Issuance Automation – Automated browser-based issuance of insurance policies by extracting data from Excel/emails, filling portals, and generating policy PDFs.

Power Platform Projects

Employee Request Management (Power Apps + Power Automate) – Built a Power Apps application with Dataverse backend, automated approvals, and email notifications.

Document Approval Workflow (Power Automate) – Automated end-to-end document approval process with dynamic routing, email alerts, and tracking, reducing manual handling by 70%.

Process Performance Dashboard (Power BI) – Developed Power BI dashboards integrating SQL DB and automation logs to visualize throughput, SLA adherence, and exception trends.

Python Projects

PDF Data Extraction Tool – Built a Python script to extract and validate structured data from invoices and reports, integrated outputs with RPA workflows.

Excel/CSV Automation Scripts – Automated bulk Excel/CSV transformations, financial reconciliations, and report generation using pandas & openpyxl.

CoE & Reporting

Blue Prism Reporting Framework – Built reporting solutions integrating SQL DB and Blue Prism Control Room logs to provide real-time tracking of automation KPIs.

Blue Prism CoE Enablement – Established reusable automation frameworks, standardized best practices, mentored new joiners, and conducted knowledge-sharing initiatives.

Healthcare Appointment Scheduling

Automated scheduling of patient appointments by integrating UiPath with hospital CRM and Outlook Calendar.

The bot checked doctor availability, updated slots, and sent confirmation SMS/emails to patients.

Reduced scheduling errors and improved patient experience by 60%.

Automated Payroll Reconciliation

Designed a UiPath workflow to reconcile payroll data from Excel, SAP, and HRMS.

Validated employee payments, allowances, and deductions with source records.

Generated monthly compliance reports and flagged discrepancies automatically.

Wipro – New Delhi, India



Software Engineer

June 2021 – November 2021

Key Responsibilities

Successfully integrated end to end process for the client and was the point of contact for the design integration, UAT, Production integration and post production change requests.

Automated process for banking using Blue Prism which included automation of Cockpit Application and uses Abbyy OCR, API, Excel Automation, PDF Generation and result mails check.

Delivered unit-tested systems within customer-prescribed timeframes.

Analysed proposed technical solutions based on customer requirements.

Collaborated with clients to define solution requirements.

Updated old code bases to modern development standards, improving functionality.

Developed clear specifications for project plans using customer requirements.

Worked with software development and testing team members to design and develop robust solutions to meet client requirements for functionality, scalability and performance.

Reviewed project specifications and designed technology solutions that met or exceeded performance expectations.

Projects

Microsoft Power BI Project on analysing sales and market aspects of an organisation’s product to provide interactive visualisations and BI capabilities with an interface to analyse sales aspects of a company.

Power Automate Project on Onboarding of New Joiners to accelerate the onboarding process, reduce HR workloads, and improve employee experience.

Developed a SharePoint–Power Automate integration for automated approval workflows and notifications, reducing manual HR interventions.

Created a Power Apps Leave Management Application with approval hierarchy, automated mails, and reporting dashboards.

Built custom Excel VBA automation solutions for finance team to consolidate reports from multiple sources, reducing turnaround time.

Sykes Digital Services (Citel Group) – Bangalore, India



Consultant

August 2018 – June 2021

Key Responsibilities

Experience in Process development, Testing and support by performing change requests for projects automated using Blue Prism.

Subject Matter Expert for multiple Automated processes.

Automated JIRA using Blue Prism for reporting purposes.

Monitoring processes and performing change requests and hot fixes in production for projects developed on Blue Prism.

Possess knowledge on process life cycle.

Introduced multiple ideas regarding working of managed services which included Team Plan, Resource Monitoring, Process Monitoring, Exception Check etc.

Supported processes involving SAP automation, Surface Automation, Cross ERP and PDF Generation.

Tracking updates and follow up for all incidents and CRs via JIRA.

Point of Contact for Change Management across the organisation.

Handled multiple challenging projects including SAP Migration and OneDrive Migration, both successfully delivered.

Implemented practices and procedures to reduce expenditures and increase savings.

Prepared presentations to explain revisions, enhancements and process improvements of organisation’s systems and programs.

Generated reports detailing findings and recommendations.

Analysed problematic areas to provide recommendations and solutions.

Collaborated with teams to define, strategise and implement marketing and web strategies.

Created and developed detailed work plans to meet business priorities and deadlines.

Projects

Designed and implemented automation for Salesforce data extraction using Blue Prism and APIs for faster reporting.

Built a document digitisation workflow using Abbyy OCR + Blue Prism to handle scanned invoices, validate against ERP, and update records.

Developed a Power BI Dashboard for operational monitoring, integrating process logs and performance data from Blue Prism to provide real-time insights.

Led the creation of a Surface Automation solution for legacy desktop systems without API access.



Certifications

Blue Prism Certified Solution Designer (ASD01)

Blue Prism Certified Professional Developer (APD01)

Blue Prism Certified Developer (AD01)

Microsoft Power Platform Fundamentals (PL-900)

Professional Scrum Master™ I (PSM I)

Automation Anywhere Certified Advanced RPA Professional (Automation 360)

Bot Developer (Automation 360)

Thoughtonomy (Blue Prism Cloud) Certified

Banking, Financial Services & Insurance Graduate – IBM

AI Agent Developer Specialization – Vanderbilt University

The Complete Agentic AI Engineering Course – Udemy

Python for Data Science and AI – IBM

Power Automate - Complete Guide to Microsoft Power Automate - Udemy

Microsoft Power Platform Fundamentals - Udemy

Process Mapping - Udemy

Achivements –

Blue Prism 2022 Customer Excellence Award Winner

Active and continuous member of Deloitte Buddy Program

Chosen and active for hiring new talent at Deloitte

Chosen as Co-Ordinating Committee Member for Robotics and Intelligent Automation Community of Practice Application (CoP) at Deloitte

Active Member of UTTHAN program of University Of Petroleum and Energy Studies to

make Undergraduate Students Ready for Industry Entrance Knowledge

Certified Of Recognition from Shell for outstanding work in RPA.

Highest Rating for the contribution in Volvo Cars

sections.label: Projects
sections.text:
Projects
Enterprise & Business Automation
Enterprise Onboarding Portal – Built on Power Pages, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and Dataverse; enabled automated workflows, document uploads, and multi-level approvals.
Vendor Payment Tracker App – Power Apps + Dataverse + Power Automate solution to streamline vendor payment processing and approval cycles.
Leave & Attendance Management Flow – Automated HR leave request and approval workflows using Power Automate.
Expense Reimbursement Workflow – Automated employee claims process via Power Apps & Power Automate integrated with Finance Dataverse tables.
Power Apps Asset Management System – Developed a low-code app with Dataverse backend for IT asset tracking and automated notifications.
Power Pages Supplier Collaboration Portal – Designed for supplier onboarding, document exchange, and approvals integrated with Power Automate & Dataverse.
Analytics & Insights
Cost Savings Dashboard – Built in Power BI, calculating Free Bot run cost savings and presenting executive-level insights.
RPA & Power BI Process Monitor – Integrated Blue Prism with Power BI to monitor bot performance and SLA compliance in real time.
Power BI Operations Dashboard – Consolidated ERP, RPA logs, and HR systems data to provide real-time operational insights.
Python Data Analytics Pipeline – Developed Python scripts using Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib for HR data analytics and operational insights beyond Power BI.
Agentic AI & GenAI Solutions
Agentic AI Knowledge Assistant – Multi-agent AI system using LangGraph, CrewAI, Autogen, Python, OpenAI GPT, Vector DBs, Groq API, and MCP for collaborative PDF/text Q&A with RAG pipelines.
Agentic AI Web Scraping & Summarization Pipeline – Python-based automation for web scraping (BeautifulSoup, Requests), GPT summarization, and PDF report generation.
Multi-Agent Process Automation Orchestrator – Python + AI-driven orchestration of
document processing, data validation, and insight generation integrated with RPA bots.
Python ETL Automation – Designed and deployed ETL pipelines in Python to extract data from APIs/Excel, transform it with Pandas, and load it into Dataverse & SQL DB.
Blue Prism + GenAI Integration – Enhanced Blue Prism workflows with Python + Generative AI for document classification and summarization.
RPA Automation (Blue Prism)
Blue Prism Invoice Processing Bot – Automated invoice extraction, validation, and ERP posting, reducing manual effort by 70%.
Blue Prism Email Automation Bot – Automated email categorization, attachment extraction, and report generation.
Cross-ERP Data Migration – Automated employee data migration between PeopleSoft and SAP HR with high accuracy.
Python + Blue Prism Hybrid Automation – Built Python services (via REST APIs) to extend Blue Prism capabilities for OCR, PDF parsing, and ML-based classification.
IT Service Desk Automation
Developed an automation for ticket triaging in ServiceNow using UiPath.
The bot categorized incidents, checked knowledge base for standard solutions, and auto- resolved low-priority tickets.
Reduced average handling time by 40% and minimized SLA breaches.
Deloitte, Bangalore, India
Consultant (Assistant Manager)
November 2021 - December 2023
Key Responsibilities
Designed and developed automation solutions across SAP, Microsoft DB, Microsoft Azure, Salesforce, Browser-based systems, Surface Automation, Cross-ERP platforms, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Python scripting, and PDF Generation using Blue Prism and Microsoft Power Platform.
Built Python automation scripts for data cleaning, file handling, web scraping, Excel/CSV processing, and PDF parsing to complement RPA workflows.
Collaborated with business stakeholders for requirement gathering, executed dry runs, and conducted UAT and smoke testing to ensure solution accuracy and reliability.
Delivered end-to-end automation ownership, including PDD/SDD documentation, development, deployment, and process optimization.
Led and implemented complex change requests, performing detailed impact analysis and delivering seamless process enhancements.
Partnered with business teams to provide user training, best practices, and adoption sessions across Blue Prism, Python automation, and Power Platform.
Administered Blue Prism environments, managing user profiles, roles, permissions, queues, and backups to maintain governance and security.
Built and automated workflows in Power Automate to streamline approvals, notifications, and data processing.
Designed and enhanced deployment guides, configuration documents, and operational manuals to strengthen delivery standards.
Created interactive Power BI dashboards to provide actionable insights into process performance, SLA adherence, and automation ROI.
Followed the system development life cycle (SDLC) from requirement analysis through successful implementation.
Mentored new joiners through the Deloitte Buddy Program and contributed to talent acquisition by conducting technical interviews.
Honored with the Blue Prism Customer Excellence Award 2022 for impactful automation delivery and best practice implementation.
Projects
Blue Prism & RPA Projects
SAP Invoice Automation – Automated invoice processing in SAP, validating records with Microsoft DB and generating PDF reports, reducing manual effort by 65%.
Salesforce Customer Data Automation – Automated customer onboarding workflows in Salesforce, integrated with Azure for document validation, and deployed successfully after UAT.
Cross-ERP Employee Data Migration – Automated employee data migration between PeopleSoft and SAP HR using surface automation, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
Insurance Policy Issuance Automation – Automated browser-based issuance of insurance policies by extracting data from Excel/emails, filling portals, and generating policy PDFs.
Power Platform Projects
Employee Request Management (Power Apps + Power Automate) – Built a Power Apps application with Dataverse backend, automated approvals, and email notifications.
Document Approval Workflow (Power Automate) – Automated end-to-end document approval process with dynamic routing, email alerts, and tracking, reducing manual handling by 70%.
Process Performance Dashboard (Power BI) – Developed Power BI dashboards integrating SQL DB and automation logs to visualize throughput, SLA adherence, and exception trends.
Python Projects
PDF Data Extraction Tool – Built a Python script to extract and validate structured data from invoices and reports, integrated outputs with RPA workflows.
Excel/CSV Automation Scripts – Automated bulk Excel/CSV transformations, financial reconciliations, and report generation using pandas & openpyxl.
CoE & Reporting
Blue Prism Reporting Framework – Built reporting solutions integrating SQL DB and Blue Prism Control Room logs to provide real-time tracking of automation KPIs.
Blue Prism CoE Enablement – Established reusable automation frameworks, standardized best practices, mentored new joiners, and conducted knowledge-sharing initiatives.
Healthcare Appointment Scheduling
Automated scheduling of patient appointments by integrating UiPath with hospital CRM and Outlook Calendar.
The bot checked doctor availability, updated slots, and sent confirmation SMS/emails to patients.
Reduced scheduling errors and improved patient experience by 60%.
Automated Payroll Reconciliation
Designed a UiPath workflow to reconcile payroll data from Excel, SAP, and HRMS.
Validated employee payments, allowances, and deductions with source records.
Generated monthly compliance reports and flagged discrepancies automatically.
Wipro – New Delhi, India
Collaborated with clients to define solution requirements.
Projects
Microsoft Power BI Project on analysing sales and market aspects of an organisation’s product to provide interactive visualisations and BI capabilities with an interface to analyse sales aspects of a company.
Power Automate Project on Onboarding of New Joiners to accelerate the onboarding process, reduce HR workloads, and improve employee experience.
Developed a SharePoint–Power Automate integration for automated approval workflows and notifications, reducing manual HR interventions.
Created a Power Apps Leave Management Application with approval hierarchy, automated mails, and reporting dashboards.
Built custom Excel VBA automation solutions for finance team to consolidate reports from multiple sources, reducing turnaround time.
Sykes Digital Services (Citel Group) – Bangalore, India
Consultant
August 2018 – June 2021
Key Responsibilities
Experience in Process development, Testing and support by performing change requests for projects automated using Blue Prism.
Subject Matter Expert for multiple Automated processes.
Automated JIRA using Blue Prism for reporting purposes.
Monitoring processes and performing change requests and hot fixes in production for projects developed on Blue Prism.
Possess knowledge on process life cycle.
Introduced multiple ideas regarding working of managed services which included Team Plan, Resource Monitoring, Process Monitoring, Exception Check etc.
Supported processes involving SAP automation, Surface Automation, Cross ERP and PDF Generation.
Tracking updates and follow up for all incidents and CRs via JIRA.
Point of Contact for Change Management across the organisation.
Handled multiple challenging projects including SAP Migration and OneDrive Migration, both successfully delivered.
Implemented practices and procedures to reduce expenditures and increase savings.
Prepared presentations to explain revisions, enhancements and process improvements of organisation’s systems and programs.
Generated reports detailing findings and recommendations.
Analysed problematic areas to provide recommendations and solutions.
Collaborated with teams to define, strategise and implement marketing and web strategies.
Created and developed detailed work plans to meet business priorities and deadlines.
Projects
Designed and implemented automation for Salesforce data extraction using Blue Prism and APIs for faster reporting.
Built a document digitisation workflow using Abbyy OCR + Blue Prism to handle scanned invoices, validate against ERP, and update records.
Developed a Power BI Dashboard for operational monitoring, integrating process logs and performance data from Blue Prism to provide real-time insights.
Led the creation of a Surface Automation solution for legacy desktop systems without API access.
